thread:
Jonah: Quick flag — ran the new quant build on model X tonight and the summarization micro-bench numbers dropped by ~6% F1 vs the int8 baseline. Repro below, short discussion please.
Priya: can you paste the exact command + seed? link to the notebook would help.
Jonah: ran: `./run_eval --model x_q4_kvpatch --task summarization --seed 42 --batch 8`
Jonah: results: ROUGE-L down 4.2, F1 down 6.1, latency improved 18% though.
Kai: hmm, that looks like a tokenization or prefix handling issue. We rolled in the ingest token-stripper last week right?
Elena: yep — the new ingest pipeline normalizes punctuation+unicode and strips leading tokens for duplication control. That could change context for long-summary prompts.
Priya: important question: were you using the current tokenizer mapping (v3) or the compatibility mapper? small remaps can shift alignment and affect F1.
Jonah: used v3 (default). I can retest with the compat mapper but we should also check whether the new kv-cache kernel interacts with small token shifts.
Kai: agree. My suspicion: quant kernel + slightly different token indices => beam search paths change and we lose safety tokens. Two quick mitigations: run quant smoke with `--compat-tokenizer` and run a short sample with the old kvcache kernel.
Elena: on the data side — we also have a fresh ingest from partner-silo (120k docs). We need to decide dedupe rules before we update any golden sets used in eval. Current plan: per-silo canonical id union -> simhash 0.9 then manual audit for edge cases.
Priya: can we avoid changing the golden eval set for the quick triage? I want the regression triage to be isolated to model/quant changes, not dataset drift.
Jonah: Agreed. Temporary plan: 1) run quant smoke on the existing stable eval gold (2k items) with compat-tokenizer + old kvcache 2) run the same subset on the new ingest subset (2k sampled) to see if data drift amplifies regression 3) only if regression persists consider expanding golden and labeling.
Elena: I can spin up a 500-item label batch for manual scoring on the new ingest subset. Tagging it `quant-smoke-ingest-030`. Will include a quick checklist for labelers: look for truncation, prompt-context loss, hallucinated facts.
Priya: @Elena awesome — can you also include metadata: original_source, ingest_pipeline_version, tokenizer_version in the batch so we can correlate?
Elena: yes — I'll add labels `src:silo-x`, `ingest:v1.3-stripper`, `tok:v3` to each item. Creating the job now: `/label create --name "quant-smoke-ingest-030" --n 500 --tags ingest:v1.3-stripper,tok:v3,src:silo-x`
Kai: I'll prepare the two quick eval runs and post artifacts to the notebook (link in a sec). If the compat-tokenizer run fixes >4% of regression, we should consider rolling the compat mapper into quant pipeline or adding a pre-tokenizer remap in the quant path.
ops-bot: deploy: test-infra/quant-smoke triggered by Jonah at 1729456825 — job id 54321
Jonah: thanks — once labelers finish the 500 we can check whether errors are concentrated on specific prompt templates. If yes, we may patch the ingest stripper to preserve those triggers.
Priya: timeline?
Elena: label batch should be ready for reviewers in ~6 hours. I'll ping when first 100 are done.
Kai: fin. I'll post preliminary eval artifacts by EOD and include a diff of tokenized sequences for the failing items.
Jonah: plan for rollback if regression confirmed and not fixable quickly: revert to previous kernel selection and pin tokenizer mapper to compat for the nightly evals.
Priya: sounds good. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
